exposure_source: CRP GWAS of CHARGE + UK Biobank (n=575,531; paper ref. 32); 12 CRP-associated variants within +/-300 kb of IL6 (IL-6 signalling downregulation instrument)

source_location: Supplementary Table 15 (sheet STable15, row 'IL6, Unspecified/other endometriosis', IVWFE columns); also Supplementary Table 14 and Fig. 7 source data
notes: Phenome-wide MR of genetically downregulated IL-6 signalling (12-variant IL6 instrument, estimates scaled to a 24% decrease in CRP) across 1,285 FinnGen R12 binary outcomes with >1,000 cases; significance = FDR-corrected P < 0.05 plus robustness filters (weighted median same direction with P < 0.05, MR-Egger intercept P > 0.05, Egger/WM concordance under heterogeneity); 66 outcomes retained (Supplementary Table 15). Among endometriosis endpoints only 'Unspecified/other endometriosis' (N14_ENDOMETRIOSIS_NOS) passed, so that subtype is the outcome; the main text lists it simply as 'endometriosis' among outcomes with lower risk. Estimate converted: Supplementary Table 15 gives scaled_beta_IVWFE -0.444378707309493 (log-odds per 24% CRP decrease) and scaled_se_IVWFE -0.108303712891859 (negative sign is an artefact of the scaling; |SE| used); OR = exp(beta), 95% CI = exp(beta +/- 1.96*|SE|). P-FDR 0.00186953922582815. Unscaled IVW in Supplementary Table 14: b 1.6192385033911, se 0.394639840051055. Sensitivity (Supplementary Table 15): MR-Egger scaled beta -0.824343739504735 (P 0.0180240040094737); weighted median -0.58530432756335 (P 9.6680195798605e-05); Egger intercept -0.0332951627374397 (P 0.191199166641343); Cochran Q P (IVW) 0.658513042218565. Endometriosis was not among the outcomes taken to external replication (Supplementary Tables 16-17). The abstract does not mention endometriosis. Instrument weights are CRP betas; the scaled estimate is per lower IL-6 signalling.

outcome_source: FinnGen R12 endometriosis of the ovary (phenome-wide MR; endpoint code not given in the main text)
instruments_location: Supplemental Digital Content Table S1 (http://links.lww.com/JS9/H14; instruments of the proteome-wide MR, cis-pQTL within +/-1 Mb, P<5e-8, r2<0.001); not available locally. PheWAS used the same selection criteria.
method: IVW (method of the EPHB4 proteome-wide MR; PheWAS method not stated separately)
source_location: Results, 'Phenome-wide MR analysis of EOAD and LOAD prior protein targets' (OR > 1, FDR < 0.05); Fig. 5; Supplemental Digital Content Table S11 (http://links.lww.com/JS9/H24, not available locally)
notes: Phenome-wide MR safety scan of five Alzheimer's target proteins (EPHB4, BTN1A1, APOE, NECTIN2, PVR) across 2469 FinnGen R12 phenotypes; significance FDR < 0.05; 152 significant phenotypes in total. Main text: EPHB4 'may be implicated in endometriosis of the ovary' among other traits, with OR > 1 and FDR < 0.05. Estimate, CI, P, case counts and endpoint code are in Supplemental Digital Content Table S11, which could not be obtained (the supplement folder holds only main figures); the Fig. 5 Manhattan plot has no trait labels. ORs in this paper are per SD increase in plasma protein. No overall-endometriosis result is mentioned, so the ovarian subtype is the outcome. EPHB4 was a Tier 1 LOAD target (IVW P-FDR 1.66E-02, coloc H3+H4 0.99 with LOAD, SMR P 1.29E-03, HEIDI P 1.64E-01; Table 1); not colocalized with endometriosis. Unrelated text inconsistency: significant associations are reported for all five proteins and then none for NECTIN2 or PVR.

notes: Phenome-wide MR of five POP druggable genes (ESR1, DES, SLC12A2, ADAMTS5, PCOLCE2) across 2514 UK Biobank traits with >1000 cases and 2440 FinnGen R11 traits; significance FDR < 0.05. ESR1 blood-eQTL MR for POP (FinnGen R11): OR 0.598 (0.500-0.717), P=2.60e-08; colocalized with POP (PP.H4 = 0.897), not with endometriosis.

notes: MR-PheWAS of genetically proxied SGLT2 inhibition across 2,803 FinnGen R5 outcomes (IEU OpenGWAS finn-b IDs); significance Bonferroni P < 1.78e-5 (0.05/2,803); 65 significant traits. Results text names endometriosis among possible side effects of SGLT2 inhibitors; the abstract and conclusion do not. Exposure: 10 SLC5A2-region variants associated with SLC5A2 expression (GTEx/eQTLGen, colocalized with HbA1c) and with HbA1c (P < 1e-4), weighted by UK Biobank HbA1c (ukb-d-30750_irnt) with betas inverted to represent inhibition, so estimates are per 1 SD lowering of HbA1c via SGLT2 inhibition; clumping r2 < 0.8 (loose); F 15.897-97.893 (Supplementary Table 2). Estimate converted: Supplementary Table 4 gives IVW beta 2.39333322, se 0.411795446 (log-odds); OR = exp(beta), 95% CI = exp(beta +/- 1.96*se). Bonferroni-corrected P 1.73225e-05.
